# THE CIRCLE

> An invite-only electronic music and art collective in Valencia, Spain. Each
> event is a single night at a secret location, combining electronic music,
> performance and visual art. Attendance is by application only.

The Circle runs a limited series of gatherings, numbered by volume (VOL. I,
VOL. II, …). Every edition has its own lineup of DJs and artists, its own
venue, and is documented afterwards in the events archive.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/): what The Circle is, recent events and the mailing list.
- [Apply for access](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/form): the application form. This is the only way to attend.
- [Past events](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/past-events): every edition so far, with lineup, venue, photos and tags.
- [DJs](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/djs): the selectors who play at The Circle, with biographies, genres and mixes.
- [Artists](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/artists): performers and visual artists, grouped by discipline.

## Legal

- [Terms and conditions](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/terms): terms of use for the site and events.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/privacy): how personal data from applications and the mailing list is handled.

## Structure

- Each event lives at `/past-events/<slug>` and carries Event structured data.
- Each DJ lives at `/djs/<slug>`, each artist at `/artists/<slug>`.
- A generated [sitemap](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/sitemap.xml) lists every published page.

## Contact

- Email: [contact@thecirclevlc.com](mailto:contact@thecirclevlc.com)
- Location: Valencia, Spain
- Site by [Alia Studio](https://www.aliastudio.cc/)

## Notes for agents

- There is no public ticketing or checkout; access is granted by the organisers after reviewing an application.
- Event locations are deliberately not published in advance and are sent to accepted applicants.
- `/admin` is a private area and is excluded in [robots.txt](https://www.thecirclevlc.com/robots.txt).
